metadata.title: A halo blue straggler on a highly eccentric retrograde orbit

notes: No star meets the eligibility criteria. J1300+0422 (SDSSJ130005.62+042201.6) is explicitly assessed as bound to the Galaxy, not as a retained Galactic unbound candidate (T:p1-b10; T:p4-b2; T:p4-b5). J0136+2425 is only cited as a previous-study “possibly unbound” HVS candidate and is not analyzed in this paper (T:p2-b4), so it is not a follow-up target here. J1539+0239 is cited as a high-space-velocity BHB without an unbound claim (T:p2-b4). J1553+0030 is excluded from analysis because of a cool companion and has no unbound claim (T:p6-b45).
